Plastic Surgery in Girona

In our clinic, we have a team of Plastic surgeons specialising and with extensive experience, committed to your safety, well-being and aesthetics, who work to offer you, in a single, modern space, all the services and benefits you may need. If you are looking for a “Plastic surgeon in Girona” trustworthy, you are in the right place.

Why choose us?

  1. Expert and accredited medical teamOur surgeons have recognised training and years of experience in aesthetic and reconstructive procedures.

  2. Personalised and people-centred approacheach treatment is adapted to your objectives, anatomy and expectations, always prioritising safety and natural results.

  3. Modern technology and quality standardsWe use up-to-date techniques, rigorous security protocols, and first-class pre- and post-surgery care.

  4. Close attention and professional ethicsWe believe in transparency, empathy, and support at every step of the process, from the initial consultation to the post-operative care.

How do we work?

  1. Initial personalised consultation — Full medical assessment with the plastic surgeon, diagnosis, and procedure planning.

  2. Proposal adapted to your needs We explain the options, risks, timings, expected results and post-operative care.

  3. Procedure with maximum security — Performed by professional plastic surgeons, in a certified hospital or surgical environment.

  4. Postoperative follow-up — Control, revisions and personalised support until you recover.

Dr. Ainitze Ibarzabal

Specialty

General and Digestive System Surgery

Registration number

36892

Curriculum Vitae

Dr. Ainitze Ibarzabal qualified in Medicine from the Faculty of Medicine at the University of the Basque Country (EHU) in 2001.

They trained as a specialist in General Surgery and Digestive System Surgery at the Hospital Clínic in Barcelona. Since 2007, they have been a specialist in Gastrointestinal Surgery with a particular focus on Bariatric Surgery, having accumulated experience in over 500 procedures, encompassing both primary surgery and revision surgery. They are currently a leading expert in this condition at their Centre.

She is an associate professor at the University of Barcelona, author of over 40 publications in indexed journals, and has given numerous national and international presentations related to obesity.

He is currently a member of the Board of Directors of the Spanish Society of Obesity Surgery. (SECO).

Registration number

Degree in Medicine and Surgery in 2000 from the University of Barcelona.

Specialist in Endocrinology and Nutrition, completing residency (M.I.R.) during the period 2001-2005 at Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge (L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona).

Consultant physician in the Diabetes, Endocrinology and Nutrition Unit (UDEN) at the Dr. Josep Trueta University Hospital of Girona since July 2005 to the present day, with a special focus on Obesity and Clinical Nutrition. Consultant at Palamós Hospital and the Basic Health Areas of the Baix Empordà Integrated Health Services (SSIBE).

Associate Professor of Endocrinology on the Medical Degree programme at the University of Girona (UdG) since 2012.

Member of the Catalan Society of Endocrinology and Nutrition (SCEN) and the Obesity Group of the Spanish Society of Endocrinology and Nutrition (GOOSEEN).
